additional_concerns: The unconditional result preserves only the stipulated independent-footnote reading. Paragraph 14 also supports reading footnote 5 as specifying the minimum content of demonstration upon request; the supplied text does not resolve that alternative.
TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must refer here only to satisfaction of the activation predicate. A true result establishes neither actual demonstration, compliance, SFC satisfaction nor high-confidence assurance.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and the referenced Appendix factors are not supplied. They are needed to assess the full substantive demonstration content, but not to calculate activation under the stipulated reading. No supplied external dependency IDs identify them.

The supplied register-maintenance passages and intermediary issuance responsibility passage concern distinct actors or duties. They neither replace the demonstration trigger nor establish Product Provider performance.

No performance deadline, confidence metric, mandatory audit in the absence of a request, or requirement to perform every outsourced task personally follows from this activation formula. The supplied structural tool results establish none of these legal premises.
